build_imagenet_dataset: build a PyTorch Dataset for ImageNet that loads images from class subdirectories and applies train or val transforms
construct_imdb_from_disk: construct an image database by scanning ImageNet class subdirectories and mapping class IDs to contiguous indices
load_preloaded_imdb: load a pre-built ImageNet image database from a JSON file for faster dataset initialization
prepare_image_with_transforms: prepare an image by applying training augmentations or validation resize and center crop transforms
get_item_with_retry: get an image and label by index with automatic retry on corrupted images using random fallback
